verseGurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verseTranslation: I met the perfect Guru, by great good fortune, and my mind has been enlightened.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translation: I met the perfect Guru, by great good fortune, and my mind has been enlightened.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translation: No one else can equal me, because I have the loving support of my Lord and Master. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translation: I am at peace in this world, and I shall be in celestial peace in the next; my home is filled with bliss. ||Pause||
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Creator, my Lord and Master.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translation: Attached to the Guru's feet, I have become fearless. I take the Support of the Name of the One Lord. ||2||

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translation: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the Form of God is deathless; He is and shall always be.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translation: He holds His humble servants close, and protects and preserves them; their love for Him is sweet to Him. ||3||

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translation: Great is His glorious greatness, and wondrous is His magnificence; through Him, all affairs are resolved.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translation: Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru; all his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||5||
